prompt: when did christmas day fall on easter monday
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly identifies that Christmas Day (Dec 25) cannot coincide with Easter Monday because Easter Monday occurs only between March 22 and April 25. Candidates 2, 3, and 4 are factually incorrect, claiming specific coincidences and even placing Christmas in dates around April, which is impossible for the holiday’s fixed calendar date. Candidate 1 is therefore the only accurate response.
